answers_to_phase_question.minimum_vertical_state_information: For the bounded B01 cohort, L3 [0-140,140-150,150-160 cm] is the minimum demonstrated storage-information candidate. This is not a universal sufficiency claim.
answers_to_phase_question.where_information_must_be_located: The decisive extra scalar is local near the active lower interface. At equal dimension, L4 explicit localization materially outperforms L3 plus a global first moment.
answers_to_phase_question.inter_layer_closure: No tested L3 storage-only or L3+M1 closure is broadly supported. Standard LARE is physically coherent and resolution-convergent; shortening the long layer is the supported repair mechanism in Phase A.
answers_to_phase_question.purpose_dependence: Short-horizon fixed-head GW response reaches a comparator-relative frontier at L4, while persistence through 1.024 day first appears at R8. Profile fidelity is stricter and comparator dependent.
answers_to_phase_question.computational_reduction: Shared-host cost signal is material for L4 (~1.94x R16 reference/candidate CPU ratio) but nearly disappears at R8 (~1.02x). These are screening ratios, not portable speedup claims.

scientific_decision: Do not pursue a universal three-layer production ROM.
Retain L4/L6/R8 as the explicit targeted-layer research ladder for transfer tests.
Do not add a second global moment or empirical correction at this point.
Do not select an application-acceptable dimension until external purpose tolerances exist.
Do not make a formal performance claim.
phase_B_gate: Freeze material/forcing transfer panel and L4/L6/R8 partitions prospectively before exposing new Reference responses. Use existing B14 transfer evidence as prior evidence, not as the only generality test.
